name: tdarr-control
description: Control of a Tdarr distributed transcoding server (v2 API) + deep codec/workflow/hardware-acceleration knowledge base. LIVE-VERIFIED on Tdarr 2.84.01 (2026-07-20): 16/16 smoke tools pass + reversible backup create/delete proof. Generic passthrough over all 67 documented /api/v2 endpoints + ~30 curated tools. The skill ships 6 deep references covering: video/audio/subtitle/container codecs (H.264/H.265/HEVC/AV1/VP9/MPEG-2/DivX, AAC/AC3/EAC3/DTS/TrueHD/FLAC, MKV/MP4/AVI, SRT/ASS/PGS), hardware acceleration (NVENC focus for RTX 3060 — hevc_nvenc/h264_nvenc preset+tune+RC reference, HDR preservation, no AV1 encode on Ampere), 6 canonical transcode workflows with real ffmpeg commands (standardize-on-HEVC, compatibility MP4, audio normalization, remux-only, subtitle extraction, 4K HDR preservation), the full 107-plugin community catalog (Migz suite, winsome, vdka tiered, etc.) organized by purpose, and Tdarr 2.x flows vs plugin stacks. All writes confirm-gated; kill-worker/disconnect-node/kill-file-scanner doubly-gated.
